matterbridgeIntro: Matterbridge runs as a supervised child process. Configure Matterbridge itself (plugins, devices, bridges) via the embedded admin tab, not here.
autostart: Start Matterbridge automatically when the adapter starts
nodeMajor: Node.js major version for Matterbridge (isolated, does not affect the system Node.js)
nodeRuntimeInfo: The adapter automatically downloads its own isolated Node.js version for the Matterbridge process only (stored under iobroker-data/matterbridge/nodeRuntime). The system Node.js used by ioBroker itself is left untouched.
dataDir: iobroker-data directory (only change if different from the default)
dataDirInfo: The Matterbridge installation/storage/Node runtime are intentionally stored here (not inside the adapter directory under node_modules), so that npm install/prune operations during updates of OTHER adapters cannot accidentally remove them.
